judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in the dataset's conversion; it is not a paper about the TV-control P300 dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension for organizing EEG data, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the TV-control P300 dataset.
